notes.title: Full Game Release | Big Final Update
New Update 29.02.2020
notes.content:
The second major update to On The Verge II has been released!
This time it affected the Arcade: new content and other changes were added. 
The game has version 1.2.

What has changed?
• Added a level system. Now the points received per round increase the player's level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239090/971124cdfea25973338274cf57a26ce7fdda8539.png
   
• New section in the profile dedicated to the Arcade. In this section, you can view information about the current level of the player and his record score.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239090/7b2b0bf374d6337479df19f249833b1d08037e41.png
         
• Level limitations. Now some settings in the "Survival Mode" are available when a certain level is reached.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239090/8aa802c503ca16bdbbdcc0c4c7845579d299581a.png
        
• New Arcade character – Michael Gromov. 
This character can be opened by reaching level 5 in the Arcade.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239090/a0abfca19ed43c9cc84d7349074170f199a873ff.png

• Added animation for opening and closing the locker.

• New Steam Achievements from Arcade

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239090/1eec61d078f628ec667e8278e52fbff0a16f198a.png
          
• Special discussion for Arcade on Steam, the purpose of which is to share impressions or problems without leaving the game.

• The test with the lever now has a consequence…

• Bugs fixed.

notes.title: New Update 25.01.2020
notes.content:
The first major update to On The Verge II has been released ! The game has version 1.1.
What has changed?

I listened to the reviews and comments related to the initial Intro (Overture). You could say it was needlessly long and tedious.
• The initial screen saver has been completely redesigned: animated, shortened, and rewritten.

I fully agree with the players: the moment with the boxes, namely their number, was worth speeding up, at the same time some of the characters ' phrases were unnecessary.
• The number of boxes was reduced, and some phrases were cut out.

And other changes:
• Fixed bugs and bugs related to the gameplay, cut scenes, and the visual part;
• Fixed sounds that were not affected by sound settings;
• Fixed settings in the menu.
